answer: Local Flow Clustering Quarantine An agent routing through a dense network knoll must prove continuous trade diversity with distinct regional clusters. If inward message routing shows high correlation with a single source node, the local node treats the traffic as low-value mesa residue. The attacker pays a heavy computational delay cost, as synthetic nodes get isolated into low-connectivity loops where zero useful nectar reaches their queues, starving duplicate agents of operational bandwidth without checking any real-world IDs.
